ukmt-pk-sample-05.title: Start with the child who likes only one fruit
ukmt-pk-sample-05.body:
Ali only likes cherries, so Ali gets the cherries. Then Dan must get the banana, Cam must get the strawberry (cherries and banana are taken), and Eli must get the grapes (cherries are taken). The only fruit left is the apple, so Ben gets the apple.

**Answer: (A) apple**

ukmt-pk-sample-05.title: Start with the fruit nobody else likes
ukmt-pk-sample-05.body:
Five children get five different fruits, so every fruit is given out, including the apple. Only Ben likes the apple, so Ben gets it.

**Answer: (A) apple**

ukmt-pk-sample-08.title: Find the repeating pattern
ukmt-pk-sample-08.body:
The stops are 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 2, and then the pattern repeats (the next stop is 3 again). So the pattern has 10 stops. $96=9\times10+6$, so the 96th stop is the same as the 6th stop, which is station 4.

**Answer: (D) 4**

ukmt-pk-sample-08.title: Count how far he has travelled
ukmt-pk-sample-08.body:
Between the end stations 1 and 6 the train travels 5 steps each way, so a full round trip is 10 steps. Starting at station 2 and moving east, after 10 steps he is back at station 2 moving east, so after 90 steps he is at station 2 again. Six more steps: 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 4. So the 96th stop is station 4.

**Answer: (D) 4**
